This page is the interactive version of the lesson notes (PDF). Each section
starts with a problem at work. Then it shows one AI job in Word. It ends
with a **Lab task** and one set of questions. The full explanations,
examples and exercises are in the notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary ai-assistant copilot-in-office prompt first-draft summary rewrite tone machine-translation check-ai-output hallucination paste-options heading-style >}}

## 9.1 Start fast: a first draft

- A **first draft** is the first version of a text. AI writes it fast.
  **You** check it, change it and format it.
- Two ways: copy from an AI chat (Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini) and paste into
  Word; or **Draft with Copilot** inside Word, if your account has it.
- The prompt has a task, the context and a format (lecture 4).
- Paste with **Keep Text Only**. Then use the styles **Title** and
  **Heading 1**.
- Huda's draft said "Free coffee for all staff." Nobody said this, so she
  deleted it.

![A first draft with AI in four steps.](images/draft-flow.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Read every line before you use it. The AI can add things that are not true.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Draft a notice"}
1. Ask an AI chat for a notice: *The library closes at 2 pm on Wednesday
   because of a meeting. Three short lines.*
2. Delete every fact that you did not give.
3. Paste into Word with Keep Text Only, use **Title**, save as `notice.docx`.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · A first draft"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="send it at once|make it bold"}
Who is responsible for the words in an AI draft?
:   you

Which paste option takes only the text from the AI chat?
:   Keep Text Only

The draft says "Free coffee for all." Nobody said this. What do you do?
:   delete it

Which three parts does a clear prompt have?
:   task, context and format

Where is Draft with Copilot?
:   in Word, if your account has it
:::
:::

## 9.2 Long text, short time: a summary

- A **summary** keeps only the main points of a long text.
- A summary can **drop** a point or **change** a number, a time or a name.
- Compare every point with the original.
- The memo: the office closes at 1 pm on Thursday; staff turn off their
  computers; the shop stays open until 6 pm; shop staff pick up the price
  list at **5 pm**. The AI summary said **3 pm**.

![Check every point of a summary.](images/summary-check.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/word-ai-lab.html" poster="sims/word-ai-lab.png" title="Word AI Lab: draft, sum up, rewrite, translate" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
If a time, a name or a number matters, find it in the original text.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Check a summary"}
1. In **Word AI Lab**, choose **Sum up**.
2. Compare each point with the memo and tap the wrong part.
3. Do the same for **Draft**.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Summaries"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the summary|the AI"}
The summary says 3 pm. The memo says 5 pm. Which is right?
:   the memo

What does a summary keep?
:   only the main points

The summary does not say that the shop stays open. What happened?
:   the AI dropped a point

What do you do with each point of a summary?
:   compare it with the original

A 6-page report, and the meeting is in 20 minutes. Which AI job?
:   a summary
:::
:::

## 9.3 Same facts, better words: rewrite

- To **rewrite** is to say the same thing in other words: more polite, more
  friendly, shorter or simpler. The facts stay the same.
- The **tone**: formal for a customer you do not know; friendly for a person
  you know well.
- Select the text. Copilot in Word: *Rewrite*. AI chat: *Rewrite this in a
  polite, formal tone: …*
- "Your order is late. It comes in 2 days. Sorry." → "Dear Mr Haddad, we
  are sorry: your order will arrive two days late."

![The same facts in three tones.](images/rewrite-tone.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/tone-lab.html" poster="sims/tone-lab.png" title="Tone Lab: one message in three tones" height="520" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A rewrite may add a promise ("a 20 % discount"). Delete what your company
did not promise.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Change the tone"}
1. Do the three tasks of **Tone Lab**.
2. In an AI chat, rewrite *Meeting moved to 10 am.* in a friendly tone.
   Check that the time stays 10 am.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Rewrite"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="translate it|delete the whole text"}
"Send the money now." sounds rude. Which AI job helps?
:   rewrite it in a polite tone

Which tone for a customer you have never met?
:   formal

Which tone for a chat with a friend?
:   friendly

The rewrite says "You get a 20 % discount." Nobody promised it. What do you do?
:   delete the promise

After a rewrite, what must stay the same?
:   the facts
:::
:::

## 9.4 Another language: translate and check

- **Machine translation** is made by a program or an AI tool. It is fast but
  can be wrong.
- In Word: **Review › Translate** › Translate Selection (or Translate
  Document).
- Check: the **days and dates**, the **numbers and times**, the **names**,
  and the **meaning**.
- The memo says Thursday. One translation said الثلاثاء (Tuesday): wrong.
- Do not paste private papers into a free online translator.

![Check days, dates, numbers and names.](images/translate-check.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Contracts, grades and personal data do not go into a public translator.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Translate and check"}
1. In Word, type *The library closes at 2 pm on Wednesday.*
2. Review › Translate › Translate Selection › Arabic.
3. Check the day, the time and the meaning.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Translate"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Home › Font|nothing, it is a machine"}
Where is Translate in Word?
:   Review › Translate

The memo says Thursday. The Arabic says الثلاثاء. Is it right?
:   no, الثلاثاء is Tuesday

What do you check first in a translation?
:   days, dates, numbers and names

Should you paste a work contract into a free online translator?
:   no, it is private

Who checks a machine translation?
:   you
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Huda's Monday morning {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Huda, the office manager of *Sunrise Company*, gets six requests: a notice
(the office closes early on Thursday at 1 pm); the main points of a 6-page
report before the 10:00 meeting; a rude e-mail, "Send the money now."; a
visitor who reads only Arabic; an AI summary that says Monday when the report
says Tuesday; and an AI draft that says "Free coffee for all staff on
Thursday", which nobody said.

{{< sim file="sims/morning-desk.html" poster="sims/morning-desk.png" title="Huda's Morning: the right AI job, the right check" kind="game" height="520" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · Huda's requests"}
Notice: close at 1 pm Thursday. Report: 6 pages. E-mail: "Send the money
now." Visitor: reads only Arabic. Choose the AI job. You can use an answer
more than once.

::: {.match extra="nothing"}
The notice
:   draft

The 6-page report
:   summarize

"Send the money now."
:   rewrite

The visitor's notice
:   translate
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 6 · Huda checks (harder)"}
The AI summary says the meeting is on Monday; the report says Tuesday. The AI
draft adds "Free coffee for all staff." Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="trust the AI|ask again and use the new answer"}
Which day is the meeting?
:   Tuesday, as the report says

What does Huda do with the summary?
:   correct it to Tuesday

What does Huda do with "Free coffee for all staff"?
:   delete it

What is always the last step before Huda uses an AI text?
:   she checks it
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- AI can draft, summarize, rewrite and translate in Word, with Copilot or an AI chat.
- Paste with Keep Text Only, then format with styles.
- A summary can drop a point or change a number: compare it with the original.
- A rewrite changes the words and the tone, never the facts.
- Check days, dates, numbers and names in a translation; keep private papers out of public tools.
